LandingPage.heroDescription: Welcome to VoteChain, the future of democracy. Our blockchain-powered platform ensures secure, verifiable, and accessible national-level voting for everyone. Participate with confidence.
LandingPage.connectWalletPrompt: Connect your wallet to get started:
LandingPage.featuresDescription: VoteChain leverages cutting-edge technology to provide a voting experience that is secure, transparent, and easy to use.
LandingPage.securityDescription: Blockchain and cryptographic techniques safeguard every vote against tampering and fraud. Decentralized authentication via Web3Auth and encrypted storage ensure privacy and integrity.
LandingPage.transparencyDescription: All voting records are stored on an immutable ledger, providing a fully auditable trail. Results are publicly verifiable on the blockchain, fostering trust in the electoral process.
LandingPage.accessibilityDescription: An intuitive interface allows voters to easily authenticate and cast their votes securely from anywhere. Designed for national scale, ensuring a smooth experience for all eligible voters.
LandingPage.ctaDescription: Connect your wallet and participate in the future of democracy, or explore the platform further.

AboutPage.title: About VoteChain
AboutPage.description: Learn more about the secure, transparent, and accessible e-voting platform built on modern technology.
AboutPage.whatIsVoteChainP1: VoteChain is a conceptual national-level e-voting application designed to demonstrate how blockchain technology and secure authentication can enhance the integrity and accessibility of elections.
AboutPage.whatIsVoteChainP2: Our goal is to provide a platform where votes are recorded immutably, results are transparently verifiable, and voters can participate with confidence using secure, user-friendly authentication methods.
AboutPage.securityDescription: Utilizing blockchain for immutable record-keeping and Web3Auth for robust, decentralized user authentication, we prioritize the security and integrity of every cast vote. Cryptographic principles ensure tamper-resistance.
AboutPage.transparencyDescription: All voting transactions (anonymized) are recorded on a public or permissioned blockchain ledger. This allows for independent verification and auditing of the results, fostering public trust in the electoral process.
AboutPage.accessibilityDescription: VoteChain aims for an intuitive user interface, allowing eligible voters to authenticate and cast their votes securely from various devices. We leverage familiar login methods via Web3Auth for ease of use.
AboutPage.blockchainDescription: Provides the decentralized, immutable ledger for recording votes securely and transparently. We use Hardhat for local development.
AboutPage.web3AuthDescription: Handles non-custodial user authentication, allowing users to log in with familiar methods (like Google, email) while managing their blockchain keys securely.
AboutPage.nextjsDescription: Provide the modern, performant frontend framework for building the user interface and handling application logic.
AboutPage.tailwindDescription: Used for rapid UI development, providing a consistent and aesthetically pleasing design system.
AboutPage.howToVoteDescription: Follow these simple steps to securely cast your vote using VoteChain.
AboutPage.howToVoteStep1Desc: Click the 'Connect Wallet & Login' button. Choose your preferred login method (e.g., Google, Email) via Web3Auth. This securely connects your blockchain identity.
AboutPage.howToVoteStep2Desc: Once logged in, go to the 'Vote' page using the header navigation.
AboutPage.howToVoteStep3Desc: Review the list of candidates presented on the ballot. Click on the radio button next to your chosen candidate.
AboutPage.howToVoteStep4Desc: Click the 'Submit Your Vote' button. Your wallet (managed by Web3Auth) will prompt you to confirm the transaction.
AboutPage.howToVoteStep5Desc: Approve the transaction in the wallet prompt. This securely records your encrypted vote on the blockchain. You'll receive a confirmation once it's processed.
